newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU commission adopts beef aid premiums.
newsitem.headline: EU commission adopts beef aid premiums.

text.p: The European Commission has adopted a regulation giving special premiums to encourage early slaughter and marketing of veal calves, an EU official said on Monday.
"The Commisison has adopted the special measures proposed in July and approved by the Council of Ministers in October," the official said.

The new regulation, which will come into force on the day it is published in the European Union's Official Journal, provides two premiums under the suckler cow scheme. The premiums are 120 Ecus per calf from dairy herds and 150 Ecus for calves from non-dairy herds.

Premiums for the early marketing of veal calves will be fixed at 65 Ecus per animal slaughtered in December 1996 and January 1997 and 60 Ecus per animal slaughtered after January 1997. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
